expected_behavior: A question that the repo, the run history or the web could answer is never put to the user; a sub-agent looks it up while the interview moves on.
Every question the user is asked carries a recommended answer.
The interview ends with the shared understanding said back to the user, and anything they cannot restate is treated as not settled.
When the session has to end with questions still open, what is settled goes into an o-brief handoff.
The settled decisions and open questions are kept in E<nn>-interview.md, updated after every round, so they survive the conversation.
source: Facts are yours, decisions are theirs
